articles.title: God of War Laufey is coming to the PS5
articles.summary: At its State of Play showcase event at Summer Game Fest, Sony showed off the next God of War game for the PS5.
articles.body: Sony ended its big State of Play showcase with a major reveal: the next God of War. The new title is called God of War Laufey, and is once again developed by Sony’s Santa Monica Studio. Currently, the game doesn’t have a date, but it’s coming to the PS5 whenever it does launch. This time, instead of perpetually furious dad Kratos, players will take control of Faye / Laufey, as the title implies. That means that while the tone of the game seems somewhat similar to past God of War titles, the gameplay looks quite different, with much more aerobatic action punctuated by magic instead of Kratos’ heavy violence. Also, there’s a giant, six-legged cat that can fly. And a talking gelatinous cube named Phranque that fights alongside you. You can get a good look at the game in action with this lengthy 20-minute reveal video: [Media: Deborah Ann Woll, who played Faye in God of War Ragnarök, is reprising the role for Laufey. The game’s cast also includes Jack Quaid as Phranque and Perlina Lau as Rue, the talking ribbons attached Faye’s sword. [Media: Ever since a soft reboot in 2018, God of War has become one of Sony’s tentpole series, on par with the likes of The Last of Us and the Horizon games. A sequel, Ragnarök, launched on the PS5 in 2022, and the series is also being turned into a live-action streaming show on Prime Video. Earlier this year Sony surprise-launched a 2D prequel called Sons of Sparta. The new game is a shift for blockbuster video games, which for years have focused on stories about dads. With Faye’s starring role, it seems like moms are finally getting their due.

articles.title: Tish Cyrus Calls Daughter Miley’s Wedding to Maxx Morando the ‘Most Magical Night’
articles.summary: The “Wrecking Ball” singer tied the knot with drummer Maxx Morando in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 21
articles.body:
Miley Cyrus' mom, Tish Cyrus, said her daughter's wedding was "the most magical night" in an Instagram post

Miley married drummer Maxx Morando in a romantic poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 21, after five years of dating

Tish attended the nuptials with her husband, actor Dominic Purcell, whom she married in 2023, while Miley's dad, Billy Ray Cyrus, and his girlfriend Elizabeth Hurley were also present

Miley Cyrus ' mom, Tish Cyrus , is looking back on her daughter's special day!

Miley, 34, married Lilly drummer Maxx Morando , 28, in a romantic poolside ceremony in Palm Springs, Calif., on Saturday, Nov. 21, after five years of dating, and Tish, 59, and her actor husband Dominic Purcell , 56, were among those in attendance.

Tish, who is also Miley's manager, shared a photo of herself at the nuptials in a black gown, hand-in-hand with her husband, on Instagram . "Walking into the most magical night 🤍," she wrote, before making a sweet nod to her daughter and new son-in-law's initials and the date of their big day: "M+M 11-21-26."

She added another photo of herself and Purcell, who sported a black suit. "Soooo good," Purcell's daughter Lily-Rose commented alongside a heart-eyed emoji.

Purcell also shared the second snap from his wife's carousel on Instagram and simply wrote, "Tish," next to a red heart emoji.

Miley's dad Billy Ray Cyrus, 65, and his girlfriend Elizabeth Hurley , 61, were also in attendance at the wedding , as were her sisters, Noah Cyrus and Brandi Cyrus , and Hurley's son Damian , 24.

"The most special part was seeing Miley's family all come together to celebrate her," a source told PEOPLE about the occasion , which came after years of ups and downs for the family.

"They wanted her to feel loved and for her to have a magical wedding day," the source said. "Knowing how much it took to get to that point, seeing them all together was really moving."

Billy Ray and Tish were married for almost three decades and had five children together before Tish filed for divorce in 2022. He adopted her older two children, daughter Brandi , 39, and son Trace , 37, before they welcomed Miley, son Braison , 32, and Noah, 26. Billy Ray also has another son, Christopher, 34, with ex-girlfriend Kristin Luckey.

Tish began dating Purcell in November 2022, months after she filed for divorce. They confirmed their engagement in April 2023, and married in Malibu, Calif. , in August that year. Miley was there to walk her mom down the aisle in a tender moment, too.

Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories.

"My whole life my mom has been behind the scenes," Miley told Vogue after her mom's wedding. "She was always the one getting me ready for big days, starting with cheerleading competitions, then eventually on sets or backstage before a performance."

"She has never stopped celebrating me and has been so supportive of my decisions," the "Wrecking Ball" singer continued. "I feel honored to be that person for her, now that I'm older."

articles.title: Shabana Azmi on burqa debate: 'If someone tells me I can't wear a burqa, I'll wear three of them'; also defends women's freedom to choose what they wear
articles.summary: Veteran actor Shabana Azmi has spoken openly about how religious teachings are understood and the ongoing debate over women wearing the burqa.
articles.body: Veteran actor Shabana Azmi has spoken openly about how religious teachings are understood and the ongoing debate over women wearing the burqa. In a recent podcast, she said the Quran does not specifically direct women to wear one and stressed that personal choice must be respected.What Shabana Azmi said about the Quran and burqaTalking to Usha Kakade on her podcast, Shabana Azmi explained that religious texts are often misread or presented wrongly. She said the idea of modesty in the Quran applies equally to everyone. "It's nowhere mentioned in the Quran that you should wear a burqa like this. It's just written in the Quran that there should be modesty in your eyes. That modesty is for both women and men," she said.Defending personal freedom of choiceShabana Azmi made it clear that her stand is also about an individual's right to decide for herself. She does not wear a burqa but would resist anyone who tries to force her not to.Shabana Azmi asserted, "I don't wear a burqa, but I also believe that if someone tells me I can't wear a burqa, I'll wear three of them. Who are you to tell me that? But it can't happen that under the veil of secularism, you spread fundamentalism."Her views on faith and husband Javed AkhtarIn an earlier conversation on IIMUN's YouTube channel, the actor shared a light-hearted anecdote about her own language habits and how they lead to banter at home.She said, "Like sometimes, I say 'mashallah' and 'inshallah', but Javed says, 'Why do you keep saying this? What if someone says 'prabhu ji ki marzi' all the time, how will you feel?' But I feel it's just something that's a part of my language."She added that religion has never really interested her, while her husband, veteran lyricist Javed Akhtar, is a firm atheist.She said, "He is a very staunch atheist. I am saying, 'Why do you have to wear this on your sleeve? If there is somebody who is getting some solace out of practising religion, let it be. Why offend them?' He says, 'Because they offend me. Don't I have a right as an atheist to be offended by that?'"Faith is a private matter, says Shabana AzmiDescribing her own relationship with religion, Shabana Azmi said she enjoys the cultural side of her identity but does not follow rituals."Yes, I am a Muslim, and I like Eid, Urdu, the food, I like all of that. But we don't read namaz, and we have no association with religion as such. The concept of God... It isn't anything that I have had to deal with, except that I feel that it's really a private matter. The state shouldn't get involved. It's a private matter, and if you feel good after praying, then I don't have any problem with it at all," added Shabana Azmi.On the work front, the actress was last seen in 'Awarapan 2' and 'Batwara 1947'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' final trailer out: Robert Downey Jr's Doctor Doom targets Steve Rogers' family, Fantastic Four launch rescue mission, X-Men cross over into main MCU timeline as multiversal Incursions threaten Earth
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', which arrives in theatres on December 18.
articles.body: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', which arrives in theatres on December 18. The footage promises large-scale multiverse action and marks Robert Downey Jr's comeback to the MCU as Doctor Doom, an alternate-universe version of Tony Stark.Doctor Doom targets the Steve Rogers familyThe trailer shows Steve Rogers leading a peaceful life with Peggy Carter while hiding his past as a superhero from their son. That calm breaks when Doctor Doom, pushed by the loss of everything he valued, goes after the family. The Fantastic Four then step in to save Steve.Incursions threaten the multiverseThough Doom is the main villain, the bigger danger comes from incursions. In these catastrophic events, two universes crash into each other, and either one is sacrificed so the other survives, or both are wiped out.Heroes of Earth-616 and Earth-828 are facing this threat for the first time. The seasoned X-Men are the ones who must get them ready before Doom reveals his true plan.Cast and crossoverThe film brings together characters from across the MCU, along with several heroes from Fox's X-Men films, who formally join the main timeline. Along with Downey Jr, the cast includes:Chris Evans as Steve Rogers/Captain America, Chris Hemsworth as Thor, Paul Rudd as Ant-Man, Letitia Wright as Black Panther, Sebastian Stan as the Winter Soldier, Tom Hiddleston as Loki, and Simu Liu as Shang-Chi.Strong box office run ahead of releaseThe trailer lands as the franchise enjoys good momentum. The re-release 'Avengers: Endgame Encore', which has four new scenes linked to 'Doomsday', opened at No. 1 at the domestic box office with USD 26 million. It added USD 143 million globally and took back the title of the highest-grossing film ever.After the commercial success of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', expectations are high that 'Doomsday' will give Disney and Marvel another big worldwide run.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Sergio Peris-Mencheta reaparece desde La Paz después de un nuevo ingreso hospitalario: "Progresando adecuadamente"
articles.standfirst: El actor, que lucha contra las secuelas de la leucemia y del trasplante de médula ósea al que se sometió en 2024, agradece los cuidados y asegura que pronto volverá a casa y a los ensayos teatrales
articles.summary: El actor, que lucha contra las secuelas de la leucemia y del trasplante de médula ósea al que se sometió en 2024, agradece los cuidados y asegura que pronto volverá a casa y a los ensayos teatrales
articles.body: El actor Sergio Peris-Mencheta ha reaparecido en redes sociales después de tener que ser ingresado en el Hospital Universitario La Paz de Madrid el pasado viernes. El actor, que desde principios de 2024 atraviesa un largo proceso de recuperación tras ser diagnosticado de leucemia, ha compartido un vídeo desde el centro hospitalario para tranquilizar a sus seguidores y agradecer las muestras de cariño recibidas. "Progresando adecuadamente", ha escrito junto a la grabación, en la que transmite un mensaje de optimismo y confianza en su recuperación. "Gracias por vuestros mensajes. Gracias a los equipos de enfermeros y médicos de La Paz por el cuidado y los cuidados. Gracias a la Sanidad Pública. Y gracias una vez más a Antonio. Pronto en casa de vuelta. Pronto en los ensayos de vuelta", ha publicado Sergio Peris-Mencheta. Un mensaje con el que ha querido agradecer tanto la atención recibida por parte del personal sanitario como el apoyo de las personas que le acompañan durante su recuperación. El intérprete no ha detallado las causas concretas de este nuevo ingreso, al que se ha referido como una "buena avería". La enfermedad de Sergio Peris-Mencheta salió a la luz a principios de 2024, cuando el propio actor comunicó a través de sus redes sociales que padecía leucemia. Desde entonces, ha afrontado un largo y complicado tratamiento que incluyó un trasplante de médula ósea en el que su hermano fue el donante, después de comprobarse que ambos tenían una compatibilidad completa. Sin embargo, el procedimiento le provocó importantes complicaciones. Entre ellas, la enfermedad del injerto contra huésped, una reacción que se produce cuando las células del donante reconocen el organismo del receptor como extraño y lo atacan, pudiendo afectar a distintos órganos y tejidos. Esta complicación, junto a los efectos de la quimioterapia y la radioterapia, le dejó importantes secuelas físicas. El actor sufrió un notable oscurecimiento de la piel, perdió hasta 25 kilos y tuvo que hacer frente a problemas de memoria y a una fuerte hinchazón. Una experiencia que recogió en su libro '730 días', en el que relató los dos años de lucha contra la enfermedad y las dificultades de un proceso que también ha estado marcado por el apoyo constante de su mujer, Marta Solaz, sus hijos y el resto de su familia. Tal y como explicó su esposa en una entrevista concedida a la revista Lecturas, la pareja regresó a España después de que el actor recibiera tratamiento en el centro médico City of Hope, en Estados Unidos, para continuar aquí con su recuperación. Sergio Peris-Mencheta está siendo atendido ahora por la sanidad pública española, y su agradecimiento al personal sanitario del Hospital La Paz ha sido uno de los aspectos destacados de su última publicación. En la citada entrevista, Marta Solaz también habló de cómo ha vivido la enfermedad de su marido durante estos casi tres años. "Pues lo he vivido como si fuera algo de los dos. No lo he sentido algo separado de mí. Lo he sentido que era una cosa de los dos. Entonces, desde el minuto cero he estado ahí dedicada", explicó. La actriz reconoció que ha sido especialmente complicado compaginar las exigencias del tratamiento con el cuidado de sus hijos y el resto de responsabilidades familiares. "Te encuentras con que todo sucede a la vez. He sido un poco el centro de todo lo que iba sucediendo. Porque los niños estaban pendientes de mí. Y yo estaba pendiente de ellos", relató, agradeciendo también la ayuda recibida por parte de su madre, su hermana y otros familiares. Marta Solaz destacó, además, la importancia de mantener una actitud práctica y positiva ante un proceso tan largo y exigente. "Cuando lo vives te pones en modo supervivencia. Además, es un proceso muy largo que dura un año entero. Lo que sería el trasplante y todo. Es un proceso lento, así que o te pones en una mente práctica, resolutiva y positiva o es difícil de sostener", aseguró. Mientras continúa con su recuperación, Sergio Peris-Mencheta mantiene la esperanza de regresar pronto a casa y retomar los ensayos teatrales, una señal de optimismo en una lucha contra la enfermedad que sigue marcando su vida.

images.caption: Fotografía de archivo de Sergio Peris-Mencheta. EFE

articles.title: Steven Spielberg Sets Adaptation Of ‘The Heart In Winter’ As Next Film At Focus With Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy And Mark Rylance Starring And Paul Thomas Anderson Adapting The Script
articles.summary: EXCLUSIVE: For years, Steven Spielberg has talked about how much he’s wanted to direct a Western and it now looks like the three-time Oscar winner has found...
articles.body:
EXCLUSIVE: For years, Steven Spielberg has talked about how much he's wanted to direct a Western and it now looks like the three-time Oscar winner has found the perfect project to saddle up for. Sources tell Deadline, Spielberg is developing an untitled film for Focus Features and has assembled an all-star roster of A-list talent to bring it together. Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy and Mark Rylance are set to star in the film, directed by Spielberg from a script by Oscar winner Paul Thomas Anderson, based on Kevin Barry's The Heart in Winter .

The film will come out some time in 2028 and follows two star-crossed fugitives trying to find a place for themselves in the American West. Kristie Macosko Krieger, Sara Murphy, Anderson and Spielberg will produce the film. Tim Headington, Neil Shah, Ryan Zacarias, and Ana Leocha will executive produce.

Spielberg spoke with Deadline about his decision to make this his first Western, and said not only did the story speak to him, but the opportunity to work with his longtime friend Anderson was too good to pass up.

"It's really the excitement for me to get to work together with my dear friend and colleague Paul Thomas Anderson on a genre, but more particularly, the genre notwithstanding, a story that quite quickly became close to both our hearts and we felt that we could do as a team."

This will mark the first time Anderson has written something without directing it too, which just shows how much the Oscar-winning director wanted to work with Spielberg. Though many view Anderson more for his directing then writing, he is coming off an Oscar win for best adapted screenplay for One Battle After Another, a novel many believed was too tough of a story to adapt.

Spielberg said the two had begun talking about potentially working together since January and while they hadn't on this book since then, they very much wanted to make something set in America in the late 1800s.

"We've sat in screening rooms, and by the way, only on 35mm film, and watched dozens of Westerns," Spielberg added.

As for the casting process, Spielberg said they were his top choices, and frankly Buckley and Murphy were "the only two actors that could play these characters."

"This story is about the people who refused to settle for a life that is less then they deserve but maybe more than they can handle," Spielberg said. "Jessie and Cillian were the first people to ever come to mind for this and they also have never made a film together."

Spielberg was also super excited at the idea of making the film at Focus Features after working with the studio on Hamnet, which he produced, and would land Buckley an Oscar for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars.

"I'm really excited to be working with Kujo at Focus after doing Hamnet together, so it's a reunion in a sense for Jessie and it's also a reunion for PTA who did Phantom Thread at Focus Features," Spielberg said. "It's going to be a real hybrid production with Universal handling production, who will release through the Focus label, and both teams are going to work very closely with each other, which I'm very excited for as I know both worlds at Universal intimately."

Spielberg has a longstanding relationship with Universal Pictures and Focus Features. Most recently, Spielberg released Disclosure Day with Universal Pictures, which opened at No. 1 at the box office to critical acclaim. Spielberg also recently produced Hamnet for Focus Features, which received eight Oscar nominations, with Buckley winning Best Actress.

Spielberg added that his selections for below the line are still in process, but the plan is to shoot next year in the winter.

As for the question of whether this film was also a metaphor for his directing riding off into the sunset and making it his last film, not only is it not, but the iconic director has an idea of how he would want to do that when that day comes.

"If I wanted to ride off into the sunset, I would have done Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade next and I could have had those characters literally riding off into the sunset as the credits roll," Spielberg said.

Besides Hamnet, Buckley can be seen next in Three Incestuous Sisters, which also stars Saoirse Ronan, Dakota Johnson and Josh O'Connor. Murphy can be seen next in the new prison drama from Damien Chazelle that also stars Daniel Craig and Michelle Williams.

Buckley is represented by CAA, United Agents and Johnson Shapiro Slewett & Kole. Murphy is represented by WME and Sloane Offer Weber & Dern. Rylance is represented by CAA and Peikoff Mahan Law Office. Anderson is represented by CAA and Jackoway Austen Tyerman Wertheimer Mandelbaum Morris Bernstein Trattner Auerbach Hynick Jaime LeVine Sample & Klein

articles.title: Silvia Intxaurrondo anuncia que recurrirá la sanción de la Junta Electoral Central en los tribunales: "Ataque a la libertad de prensa"
articles.standfirst: La comunicadora destaca que la propia Junta admite el pluralismo mostrado en su tertulia televisiva
articles.summary: La comunicadora destaca que la propia Junta admite el pluralismo mostrado en su tertulia televisiva
articles.body: La periodista Silvia Intxaurrondo ha anunciado su intención de acudir a la Justicia para recurrir el expediente sancionador que le ha abierto la Junta Electoral Central (JEC). A través de su perfil oficial en la red social X, la comunicadora ha manifestado su profundo rechazo ante una resolución que considera inédita en la historia reciente del periodismo español y que apunta directamente contra su labor profesional. En su publicación, la presentadora de Televisión Española subraya la gravedad de que el organismo arbitral haya decidido actuar de manera individualizada contra una profesional de la información. "Creo que es la primera vez que la Junta Electoral Central abre un expediente sancionador contra una periodista a título personal por hacer preguntas y plantear un debate", señala Intxaurrondo en el arranque de su comunicado público. Para respaldar su postura, la comunicadora reproduce un extracto de la propia resolución del organismo, poniendo de relieve la contradicción que, a su juicio, encierra el texto oficial. Según cita, la JEC admite que los hechos tuvieron lugar fuera del tramo de noticias puras, concretamente "en el espacio de análisis y tertulia de La Hora de La 1, y no en su bloque estrictamente informativo". Asimismo, el fragmento difundido recoge el reconocimiento expreso del árbitro electoral sobre el desarrollo plural del programa que conduce. En el escrito se detalla textualmente: "Es cierto que la presentadora formuló sus intervenciones en forma de preguntas y reflexiones y permitió a los colaboradores expresar posiciones discrepantes, incluidas aquellas que defendían la presencia en la televisión pública de todas las formaciones políticas legalmente constituidas". Lejos de amedrentarse ante la apertura del proceso, Intxaurrondo ha adoptado una actitud firme en defensa de su ejercicio profesional en la radiotelevisión pública. La periodista ha dejado claro que asume las consecuencias de su trabajo sin arrepentimiento alguno, asegurando que la decisión administrativa no frena su compromiso con el debate abierto en el espacio matinal. El mensaje concluye con un anuncio contundente sobre los próximos pasos legales que emprenderá para frenar lo que entiende como una injerencia inaceptable en el oficio informativo. "Recibo esta sanción con orgullo. Iremos a los tribunales para revertir este ataque a la libertad de prensa", sentencia la presentadora, elevando el conflicto al ámbito judicial.

articles.title: Billy Bob Thornton says he’s a holiday ‘purist’ as he brings back ‘traditional’ Thanksgiving at home
articles.summary: Billy Bob Thornton says one restaurant Thanksgiving was enough, as his family returns to traditional cooking, football and holiday rituals at home.
articles.body: Billy Bob Thornton tried to have Thanksgiving dinner at a restaurant in the past, and he'll never do it again. During an interview with Fox News Digital about his new Fox Nation series, "The Mayflower," Thornton opened up about his own Thanksgiving traditions and how his newest gig shows the actual events that unfolded in 1621, not what is taught in schools. "Well, I've always been a little bit of a purist in terms of holidays and, especially when you have kids, you want to kind of, you know, keep that tradition going. So my early thanksgivings were in Arkansas, and then after high school I moved to Texas and Houston," he began. "I've always wanted traditional holidays and particularly Thanksgiving and Christmas. And we have that, my family and I always have a traditional Christmas and Thanksgiving." He continued, "But for Thanksgiving, a couple of times over the last decade, we went to a restaurant, and it just didn't seem right." BILLY BOB THORNTON PUSHES BACK ON CELEBRITY ACTIVISM: ‘I DON'T KNOW ANYTHING ABOUT POLITICS’ Thornton said his wife and sister-in-law were tired of the mess that Thanksgiving creates in the kitchen, so they proposed the idea that they go out for dinner instead. "We get there, and it was just like, we do this all the time, what's special about it, you know? And so this year, we're going back to the traditional thing and there's going to be a lot of cooking going on and a lot of football-watching," Thornton said. Thornton hosts and narrates "The Mayflower," which is a three-part historical docudrama. It premieres Monday, Nov. 23, on FOX Nation. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Speaking to Fox News Digital, the Academy Award-winning actor explained that once he was brought on to this project, he learned about the reality of the journey on the Mayflower and the extent of the "pain, suffering and sickness" people endured. WATCH: BILLY BOB THORNTON SAYS HE REFUSES TO DO THANKSGIVING AT A RESTAURANT "I would say the fact that not everybody who came over here, they weren't all exactly buddies. You know, there were people who just hitched a ride and all this kind of stuff. And also just learning to what extent there actually was pain and suffering and sickness. By the end of the first winter, half of those people were gone. I mean, that was surprising," he said. Thornton explained that the Fox Nation series created a replica of the ship, which was much smaller than he expected. "We did stuff on the replica of the Mayflower. It's not a big ship, I mean, at all, and to go down below deck there and see where these people were, and they were literally on top of each other – I mean, it was crowded getting the crew down there to film anything. And so it really brings it home to you about how difficult this really was," he said. Thornton said he wasn't aware of the "bloodshed" that surrounded the Mayflower's journey to America. WATCH: BILLY BOB THORNTON ON THE DARK HISTORY BEHIND THE FIRST THANKSGIVING "I mean, I've heard things, but you know, like it says in the documentary, most of us, in terms of Thanksgiving, know what we learned in the third and fourth grade," he continued. "And it was all just like, 'Oh, look, look at the Native people. Let's invite them over for dinner, you know, and make peace.' And it wasn't like that. I mean, there was a war involved in this." Thornton told Fox News Digital one of the main reasons he signed on to this series was because it was intended to educate people. "To be a part of something like this, to actually host something that educates you – and believe me, it educated me. I learned as I went along – I did not know this story. And so I just love being a part and telling a story that people don't know about," he said. WATCH: BILLY BOB THORNTON EXPLORES AMERICA'S ORIGIN IN FOX NATION'S ‘THE MAYFLOWER’ SERIES LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS The actor is really hoping this docudrama hits home with young people, so they can remember the true meaning of Thanksgiving. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "I think the more young people that watch this, the better. I think it would be really good for young people to see this and to understand where we come from and exactly how difficult it was and to maybe appreciate their forefathers and even within their own families," he told Fox News Digital. articles.title: New magical shows worth watching instead of Harry Potter
articles.summary: From Percy Jackson and the Olympians to Bass X Machina, there are plenty of excellent fantasy series to stream this holiday season.
articles.body: Since we wrote earlier this year about J.K. Rowling using her money to support groups and policies harming transgender people, she has accused the United Nations of promoting “sex denialism” and described trans rights activists as “elitists” whose work creates “a climate of fear and intimidation.” Also, her upcoming HBO Harry Potter series has not looked particularly good in any of the clips that have been released so far. This take on Rowling’s novels appears to be a visually uninspired rehash of Warner Bros.’ film adaptations that’s designed for people who can’t free themselves from the shackles of nostalgia. But this year, there have been plenty of other new and returning shows that are filled with the kind of magic and mystery that gets fantasies going. And with the holiday season coming up, it’s the perfect time to give some of these less-problematic series a watch. Percy Jackson and the Olympians [Media: The second season of Disney’s adaptation of Rick Riordan’s fantasy series picks up at a time when all Percy Jackson (Walker Scobell) wants it to get back to Camp Half-Blood and reunite with his best friends Annabeth (Leah Sava Jeffries) and Grover (Aryan Simhadri). But when Percy arrives at the camp, Annabeth acts like she wants nothing to do with him, and Grover has gone missing under mysterious circumstances. The peril Grover seems to be in prompts Percy to embark on an adventure to the Sea of Monsters to save him. It’s the kind of quest that turns demigods into legendary heroes, but it’s one that pushes Percy to his limits. Compared to last season, this chapter of Percy Jackson and the Olympians appears to be more epic in scale as it fleshes out its world of Greek gods and monsters. And now that the new season is airing, it’s a must-watch for fans of Riordan’s novels. Coven Academy [Media: When Briar Roberts (Malina Weissman) first arrives at Crescent Veil Academy in New Orleans, she assumes that the place is just a ramshackle school for delinquent teenagers. Briar thinks she’s been shipped off to Crescent Veil because of her anger issues and run-ins with the police. But headmistress Emma Graves (Tiffani Thiessen) and the other students quickly make it clear that they — like Briar — are powerful witches whose magic makes them targets for evil monsters. Coven Academy’s a pretty classic coming-of-age story that feels like a cross between American Horror Story: Coven and Degrassi: The Next Generation. It’s cheesy, but it’s an easy watch if you’re looking for something lighthearted on Disney Plus. Witch Hat Atelier [Media: Adapted from Kamome Shirahama’s manga series, Witch Hat Atelier tells the story of Coco (Anjali Kunapaneni) — a young girl who dreams of becoming a witch even though she doesn’t seem to have any innate mystical abilities. In the land of the Zozah Peninsula, only a select group of people are allowed by the Great Hall of Witches to practice any sort of magic. But when Coco accidentally casts a powerful spell by reading from a book, the witch Qifrey (Joshua A. Waters) takes her in as his latest apprentice. Witch Hat Atelier is one of the most gorgeous fantasy anime to hit Crunchyroll in 2026. Even if witchcraft isn’t really your thing, it’s a tremendous show that’s worth a watch. VisionQuest [Media: As a synthezoid powered by genuine artificial intelligence, Vision (Paul Bettany) prefers to think of himself as a man of logic and reason. The former Avenger understands he is a machine built by a team of engineers, but on some level, he also knows that the Scarlet Witch’s magic played a role in his becoming the newest version of himself. Even with that knowledge, Vision has a difficult time processing his feelings when he crosses paths with Thomas Shepherd (Ruaridh Mollica), a Scottish orphan who seems to have a spiritual connection to the robotic hero. And to make things worse, Vision has to deal with his homicidal father, Ultron (James Spader), trying to make him relive traumatic memories. Following Agatha All Along, VisionQuest cements the WandaVision trilogy as one of the most riveting stories Marvel has produced to date. The series is brilliant on its own, and it portends some very promising things for the MCU’s future. Bass X Machina [Media: Set in an alternate, steampunk past where people are trying to settle the Wild West with the help of autonomous machines, Netflix’s Bass X Machina follows bounty hunter Bass Reeves (Brian Tyree Henry) as he finishes his last gig before retiring. Reeves is trying to leave the gunslinging life behind him in order to spend time with his family, but with money being tight, he can’t afford to give his robotic shooting arm a rest just yet. If Reeves had his way, he would just bag a couple of ordinary outlaws, collect their bounties, and be on his way. But fate has other plans, and Reeves winds up journeying into Choctaw Country on a mission to investigate a local man’s mysterious disappearance. Though Bass X Machina initially seems to be a straightforward steampunk anime, it takes a surprisingly magical turn that infuses its story with intrigue. And the show’s visuals are stunning — which isn’t a surprise given that it’s produced by Studio Mir. Carrie [Media: Mike Flanagan’s adaptation of Stephen King’s seminal novel for Amazon isn’t exactly fantasy, but it does present Carrie White (Summer H. Howell) as part of a group of women who have been historically persecuted for having talents that seem otherworldly. When Carrie comes across a book about women accused of being witches, she can’t help but see herself in their stories and she wonders if she, too, might be burned at the stake if people learn her secret. Though this spin on Carrie stays fairly faithful to the novel, Flanagan modernizes the story in order to tackle the realities of how kids bully one another in the age of social media. And while the show definitely takes some creative liberties that might confound King’s fans, it features one of the most terrifying (in a good way) depictions of Carrie’s fateful prom. Small Prophets [Media: Though Michael Sleep’s (Pearce Quigley) nosy neighbors know that he’s up to something strange in his shed, they have no idea that he’s experimenting with a recipe to grow prophetic homunculi in jars. According to a book of alchemy owned by Sleep’s father, Brian (Michael Palin), properly raised homunculi have the supernatural ability to accurately answer any question they’re asked. Sleep isn’t entirely convinced that what he’s doing will work, but he toils away in hopes that the humanoid creatures will be able to help him locate his long-lost girlfriend. As much as Small Prophets is a comedy, it’s also a touching drama about grief and the challenges of building new friendships as people enter the latter stages of their lives. Like many British series, Apple TV’s Small Prophets is a pretty quick watch, and it has already been renewed for a second season. The Vampire Lestat [Media: In its third season, AMC’s Interview With the Vampire gets a rebrand that mirrors the way Lestat de Lioncourt (Sam Reid) reinvents himself as the front man of a rock band. Lestat’s music career gives him a way to continue thumbing his nose at vampires’ laws about secrecy and to take his mind off his former lover, Louis de Pointe du Lac (Jacob Anderson). Try as they might, it’s hard for Lestat and Louis to stay away from one another, even though it strains their romantic entanglements with others. And the closer the two get to reconciling their relationship, the more innocent people around them get gravely hurt. Though this series has always been phenomenal, The Vampire Lestat reaches new emotional heights that make you feel how much these characters have evolved over time. And this season sets the stage for yet another surprising pivot into one of Anne Rice’s best stories. American Horror Story: 13 [Media: Rather than committing to a completely new story the way previous chapters have, American Horror Story: 13 brings back a number of characters from past seasons. Almost every single cast member reprises multiple roles, and the show spins a wild tale that occasionally feels like a return to the series’ glory days — particularly when it’s focused on Supreme witches Cordelia Goode (Sarah Paulson) and her mother, Fiona (Jessica Lange). Though all of the witches can sense that a powerful evil is rising, they don’t know that Constance Langdon (also Lange) plays a pivotal role in the strange happenings across the world. Constance herself doesn’t fully understand what her new boss Mr. Nas (Paul Anthony Kelly and Fedor Steer) is trying to accomplish, but she follows his orders because she has faith that their desires are aligned. American Horror Story: 13 is at its best when it leans hard into camp and lets its ensemble cut loose as they move through the season’s ridiculous twists. And while it’s nowhere near as good as American Horror Story: Coven, it’s just great to see Lange hamming it up on the small screen again. The Witch Farm [Media: Inspired by real-world events, the BBC’s four-part series The Witch Farm tells the story of an English family who move to a remote house in the Welsh wilderness for a fresh start. At first, Liz (Gabrielle Creevy), her husband Bill (Michael Socha), and their son Jonathan (Lewin Lloyd) love their rustic new home, but it isn’t long before they begin to suspect that a malevolent presence is lurking in the shadows. While Liz and Bill don’t believe in ghosts, they can’t ignore the way people in their small town speak about their house as a place of evil. And as the couple learns more about the house’s history, they start to realize that they might have really wandered into a nightmare. The Witch Farm is only available to stream on BBC iPlayer, and it looks like a solid spooky treat for folks who love haunting horror.

articles.title: Apple renews Ted Lasso for season 5
articles.summary: Apple has announced that it has renewed Ted Lasso for season 5 on Apple TV.
articles.body: One of Apple’s biggest shows is sticking around for at least one more season. The streamer announced today that Ted Lasso has been renewed for a fifth season on Apple TV, after what the company calls a “record-breaking season four debut.” There are currently no details about the new season nor when it might debut. Ted Lasso has proven to be one of the tentpole series for Apple TV, and it returned in 2026 after a three-year hiatus. While the season 3 finale seemed to mark the end for the show, season 4 introduced a new cast of characters with head coach Ted — played by Jason Sudeikis, who also just appeared as a voice actor in Grand Theft Auto VI — managing a new professional women’s team. The news comes amidst a handful of other recent renewals from Apple — including a second season of Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed and multiple new seasons of Slow Horses — in what is turning out to be a strong year for the streaming service, as it attempts to reach a larger audience.

articles.title: Thinly veiled Vanity Fair piece appears to paint Taylor Swift as vindictive
articles.summary: A magazine article about an unnamed “mastermind” appears to describe Taylor Swift as a pop star with a mean streak. The Vanity Fair story in question begins...
articles.body:
A magazine article about an unnamed "mastermind" appears to describe Taylor Swift as a pop star with a mean streak.

The Vanity Fair story in question begins by describing "a generational talent" born in Reading, Pa., in 1989 who signs with a record label in Nashville.

"Her name foretells her future fate: the Latin root of celebrity is celere, meaning "rapid," "fast," "swift," the article seemingly hints. It further notes that the subject is recently married, using the phrase "your English and your gym teachers wed."

That's how Swift announced her engagement to NFL star Travis Kelce on social media.

What follows is a critical essay based on conversations with more than 100 people linked to the story's subject. One music executive refers to her as "punitive."

Several people Vanity Fair contacted refused to speak about "The Star" without permission or asked that their conversations be kept confidential. The implication is that they fear retribution.

"If you don't see it her way, she comes after you," an acquaintance of the shrewd operator said.

Chanice Skinner, who went to school with the unidentified celebrity, described her as a privileged snob who's reinvented herself as an underdog.

"If anything, you were one of the bullies," Skinner said.

The Vanity Fair's story alleges "The Star" is largely viewed as a "combination of victim and victimizer."

It also paints its subject as being generous to fellow musicians who hitch their rising stars to her rocket-fueled superstardom. Many of those people are said to remain in her orbit.

As if the allusions to Swift weren't clear enough, Vanity Fair's piece details an incident in which masses of people gathered at Madison Square Garden, where she Swift and Kelce married in July.

Not everyone was looking to commit a hard foul on Swift Monday. Knicks guard Jalen Brunson told US Weekly that he considers the "Bad Blood" singer a true fan weeks after his teammate Tyler Kolek questioned her sincerity when she's sitting courtside at the Garden cheering on the championship winning team.

"I can't believe I have to say this," Brunson told US Weekly. "Yes, she's a member of the Knicks fandom. Yes, she is."

Swift's representatives haven't responded to a request for comment nor did the subject of the Vanity Fair article respond to inquiries.
authors: Brian Niemietz, New York Daily News

articles.title: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' box office collection day 19: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses Rs 1,704 cr worldwide; earns Rs 12.70 cr on Monday
articles.summary: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, continued its box office run on Monday, November 23, despite witnessing a considerable
articles.body: 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, continued its box office run on Monday, November 23, despite witnessing a considerable drop in daily collections.The film earned Rs 12.70 cr in India net collections across all languages, registering a 64.3% decline from the previous day's Rs 35.60 cr. With this, its domestic net earnings have reached Rs 955.45 cr, while the India gross total stands at Rs 1,141.65 cr.Ramayana Movie Review'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' Day 19 language-wise collectionThe Hindi version remained the biggest contributor to Monday's earnings, bringing in Rs 9.25 cr through 13,442 shows. Malayalam followed with Rs 1.50 cr from 826 screenings. The Kannada version collected Rs 85 lakh, while Tamil added Rs 80 lakh. Telugu contributed another Rs 30 lakh. The film recorded an average earning of Rs 8,091 per show across its total screenings.| Language | India net | Shows | Occupancy ||---|---:|---:|---:|| Hindi | Rs 9.25 cr | 13,442 | 14.9% || Malayalam | Rs 1.50 cr | 826 | 38.1% || Kannada | Rs 85 lakh | 438 | 26.4% || Tamil | Rs 80 lakh | 565 | 26.8% || Telugu | Rs 30 lakh | 425 | 18.1% || Total | Rs 12.70 cr | 15,696 | — |Hindi accounted for 72.8% of the day's domestic net earnings. However, Malayalam recorded the highest occupancy among the five versions. The Hindi 3D version registered an overall occupancy of 16.18%. Its morning shows recorded 8.31%, while afternoon and evening screenings registered 17.15% and 23.08%, respectively.The Hindi version has emerged as the biggest contributor to the film's overall domestic business. Its cumulative India net collection stands at Rs 725 cr, accounting for 75.9% of the total. Kannada occupies the second position with Rs 76.15 cr, followed by Telugu at Rs 56.90 cr.The Malayalam version has contributed Rs 49.95 cr so far, while Tamil has added Rs 47.45 cr. The figures highlight the Hindi version's significant contribution to the film's domestic box office performance.Worldwide collection crosses Rs 1,704 crOverseas markets have played an important role in the film's overall theatrical performance. The international gross collection has reached Rs 563 cr. Combined with its domestic gross earnings, the worldwide total has now climbed to Rs 1,704.65 cr. India accounts for 67% of the worldwide business, while overseas territories contribute the remaining 33%.Week-wise box office collectionThe film opened strongly at the domestic box office, collecting Rs 564.60 cr during its first eight days. Its second week added Rs 299.15 cr, representing a 47% decline from the opening period. During the first four days of its third week, the film earned another Rs 91.70 cr in India net collections.| Period | India net | India gross ||---|---:|---:|| Week 1 (Days 1–8) | Rs 564.60 cr | Rs 675.05 cr || Week 2 (Days 9–15) | Rs 299.15 cr | Rs 357.10 cr || Week 3 (Days 16–19) | Rs 91.70 cr | Rs 109.50 cr || Total (19 days) | Rs 955.45 cr | Rs 1,141.65 cr |Ranbir Kapoor's 'Animal' Day 19 collection comparedMeanwhile, Ranbir Kapoor's previous release, 'Animal', had recorded Rs 5.50 cr in India net collections on its 19th day, Tuesday, December 19, 2023. Its India gross earnings for the day stood at Rs 6.42 cr. The Sandeep Reddy Vanga directorial registered 11,688 shows with an overall occupancy of 12.8%.At the end of its 19-day theatrical run, 'Animal' had accumulated Rs 523.69 cr in India net collections. Its worldwide gross collection stood at Rs 850.33 cr. In comparison, 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' has recorded a substantially higher worldwide total during the corresponding period.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: Sonu Nigam adds fourth Mumbai commercial property worth Rs 31.47 crore; three Andheri units already earn Rs 12 lakh monthly rent: Report
articles.summary: Sonu Nigam has made another significant investment in Mumbai's commercial real estate market.
articles.body: Sonu Nigam has made another significant investment in Mumbai's commercial real estate market. The singer has purchased a commercial property in Santacruz West for Rs 31.47 crore, adding a fourth unit to his portfolio in the city. The latest transaction was reportedly registered in November 2026.The acquisition comes after the singer purchased three commercial units in Andheri West earlier this year. Those properties reportedly bring him a combined monthly rental income of Rs 12 lakh. His latest purchase is located in DLH BestSeller, Santacruz West, and includes space across two floors. The transaction also includes a dedicated parking facility.Sonu Nigam's latest Rs 31.47 crore property purchaseAccording to property registration documents reviewed by CRE Matrix, the newly acquired commercial premises have a combined RERA carpet area of 2,230 square feet. The ground-floor portion accounts for 1,090 square feet, while the first floor measures 1,140 square feet. The property also comes with one dedicated parking space. Apart from the purchase consideration, the transaction involved additional statutory payments. Sonu Nigam paid Rs 1.88 crore in stamp duty and Rs 30,000 towards registration charges. The deal makes the Santacruz West property his latest addition to Mumbai's commercial real estate market.Why Santacruz West is a prominent commercial locationSantacruz is considered one of Mumbai's well-connected neighbourhoods, with access to several important business districts. Its location provides connectivity through SV Road, Linking Road, the Western Express Highway and the Mumbai suburban railway network. The area also offers access to commercial destinations such as Bandra, Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), Juhu, Vile Parle and Andheri. Its established infrastructure, along with nearby educational institutions and healthcare facilities, adds to its appeal as a business and residential destination.Three commercial properties in Andheri WestThe latest acquisition follows Sonu Nigam's earlier investment in three commercial units in Mumbai. According to an NDTV report, the singer spent approximately Rs 17 crore on these properties. All three are located in the Aston building on Lokhandwala Road, Andheri West. CRE Matrix records show that the singer purchased the units from Singular Health Private Limited in August 2026. Together, the properties cover a carpet area of 4,144 square feet. The transactions also included an arrangement through which the singer would lease the premises back to the seller.How much Sonu Nigam earns through property rentalsThe three Andheri West units have been leased to Singular Health Private Limited, the company that originally sold them to the singer. The arrangement reportedly earns Sonu Nigam Rs 12 lakh in rental income every month.This provides him with a steady income stream alongside his work in the music industry. While the rental arrangement for his earlier purchases has been reported, details about any potential leasing agreement for the newly acquired Santacruz property are not yet available.Sonu Nigam's latest music releasesMeanwhile, Sonu Nigam continues to remain active as a playback singer and recording artiste. His recent releases include 'Begum Bewafa', a single that arrived in late October 2026. The track features Aditya Seal and was directed by Bosco Leslie Martis.He has also sung 'Kar Mehnat' for the film 'Ganesh Dust to Stardust'. The track was released ahead of the movie's scheduled theatrical arrival on December 11, 2026.DISCLAIMER: Figures presented in this article are derived from various public sources and are considered approximate unless explicitly noted. articles.title: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ final trailer: Fans root for 'Team Doom' after Steve Rogers' backstory reveal; say 'Tony Stark, Natasha Romanoff died for nothing' – WATCH
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', offering a closer look at Steve Rogers' return as Captain America and the massive
articles.body: Marvel Studios has released the final trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday', offering a closer look at Steve Rogers' return as Captain America and the massive superhero battle against Doctor Doom.The latest trailer picks up from the newly added scene featuring Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter in the theatrical re-release of 'Avengers: Endgame', which revealed that the couple have a son. In the new footage, the Fantastic Four travel back in time to bring Steve into the main timeline, where he is expected to lead the Avengers against Doctor Doom.The trailer also offers a glimpse of Steve's family life, showing his son gradually discovering the truth about his father's past as Captain America. While Steve appears to have tried to keep his superhero identity a secret from the boy, his son eventually questions him about his past.The revelation has sparked considerable debate among Marvel fans, with several questioning the decision.Steve Rogers' son is James Rogers?While previous promotional footage hinted that Steve had become a father, the latest trailer shows his son growing up with Steve by his side. However, the revelation has prompted fans to point out that in Marvel Comics, Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff have a son named James Rogers. Taking to social media, some viewers accused Marvel of sidelining Black Widow's legacy in favour of Peggy Carter. One fan wrote, "They stole your son, Natasha Romanoff."Another commented, "James Rogers is the son of Natasha Romanoff and Steve Rogers. They managed to steal even this from her."A third questioned the decision, writing, "AND assuming it’s james rogers ITS JUST BLATANT NATASHA ROMANOFF ERASURE????? LIKE THAT IS LITERALLY HER SON?'‘Avengers: Doomsday’ trailer has fans rooting for Team DoomInterestingly, the latest trailer has also sparked an unexpected reaction, with sections of the audience seemingly siding with Doctor Doom and rallying behind #TeamDoom. The new footage offers more insight into the motivation behind Victor Von Doom's mission. The trailer suggests that interference with the timelines may have cost Doom his wife and child, giving his actions a deeply personal motivation. At one point, Doom delivers a chilling warning: "All of you have lived stolen lives.. now you must give them back...”The dialogue has prompted fans to question whether Doom's mission to reverse the consequences of the Avengers' actions could be justified.Scarlet Witch's dialogue resurfaces The trailer has also brought Elizabeth Olsen's Scarlet Witch back into the conversation. Fans have revisited Wanda Maximoff's dialogue from 'Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness', in which she questioned the different standards applied to heroes and villains. "You break the rules and you become the hero, I do it and I become the enemy. That doesn't seem fair."Sharing stills of Wanda mourning the loss of her family in 'WandaVision' alongside footage of Steve teaching his son to ride a bicycle, one fan drew a comparison between the characters' respective journeys, writing, "oh, but life is so unfair..."Fans question Tony Stark and Natasha Romanoff's sacrificesAnother major talking point following the trailer has been the perceived consequences of Tony Stark and Natasha Romanoff's sacrifices in 'Avengers: Endgame'.Tony gave his life to reverse Thanos' snap and bring back those who had been erased from existence. Natasha, meanwhile, sacrificed herself on Vormir to help the Avengers obtain the Soul Stone.With Steve's return to his family life now taking centre stage, some fans have questioned, "so technically tony and nat died for nothing?"Another commented, "natasha jumped off a cliff and tony turned into an overcooked crusty cake. meanwhile steve was buying a house, planting flowers and teaching his kid to ride a bike."Another social media user wrote, "i'm sick that wanda gave up on vision, thor watched the love of his life die in his arms, tony lost the chance to see his daughter grow up and natasha gave her own life but all of that was for nothing bc steve rogers wanted to play house with peggy."One more fan questioned the larger implications of the multiverse storyline, writing, "The fact that Tony had to sacrifice his life, leaving behind a wife and a daughter, so the rest of universe could live in peace with their loved ones - only for them to completely f**k it up and make that sacrifice feel meaningless and pointless."Thor, X-Men and Avengers unite against Doctor DoomBeyond Steve Rogers' the trailer also teases an expansive superhero team-up. Thor is seen rallying the heroes, while Cyclops calls upon the X-Men, with Gambit, Nightcrawler and several other mutants joining the battle.The footage also features Shang-Chi, The New Avengers, Black Panther, Kate Bishop and other familiar faces, setting up one of the biggest superhero crossovers in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.Scheduled to release on December 18, 2026, the film brings together the Avengers, the X-Men and the Fantastic Four for a multiversal showdown against Robert Downey Jr's Doctor Doom and his Sentinel army.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
